narration.transcript: Want the look of old timber beams without the weight? Meet Heritage Timber from Ekena Millwork. Each beam is molded from real, weathered timber with no corner seams. Pick from six textures, Mina, salvaged timber, rustic sawn, resawn rip, reclaimed axe cut, and sanded smooth, then a hand-stained finish, sandstone, Kona Brown, vanilla chai, warm caramel, natural white oak, smoky brown, or primed, ready to paint. Eight sizes, from three and a half inches square to nine and a half by eleven and a half, in lengths from four to twenty-four feet. They're hollow, so they slide over a wood block on your ceiling and can hide wiring. And they ship fast, stained beams in three to five business days, primed in about one to three days. Order a sample and see it in your own light.

scenes.comment: Ekena vaulted-room render (BMSTKB-09); beams in frame in both cuts from f0; card and word captions track the line.

Real sample-kit and endcap photos, real logo; starts on the track's lift at 55.8 s.

findings.source: Claim H16 source: 'Site for the end card to be confirmed by Brody'; beam-lines-facts.md retrieved every fact from FauxBeams.com
findings.what: The end card still sends viewers to 'ekenamillwork.com'. Its claim (H16) still says the destination is to be confirmed by Brody; unchanged since v2 and v3 (v3 e2).
findings.fix: Brody to choose ekenamillwork.com or FauxBeams.com. Then set the CTA in build/script-v4.json#end (timeline key 'end' in render/videos/heritage-hero.mjs) and update H16's source to record the decision.

findings.what: Every scene boundary sits within a frame of a beat (checked against the delivered audio: music offset 0.320 s), but each transition is an eased-in wipe that barely moves for the first 6-9 frames and peaks 17-19 frames (about 0.3 s) after the beat (wipe peaks at f295, 763, 1356, 2075, 2584, 2923, 3347 for boundaries 278, 744, 1337, 2057, 2566, 2905, 3328); the tech-check unexpected_cuts flags (f289, f296, f773 in 16:9; f1250, f2077, f2571 in 9:16) are these planned wipes, not glitches. On screen the change reads as landing between beats rather than on them.
findings.fix: One shared cause in the transition helper (render/lib/core.mjs): centre the wipe's fastest point on the boundary frame (start it about half its length earlier) or use an ease-out so the visible hit coincides with the beat.

findings.what: The 'Primed only' pill still rides in with the wipe to Sanded Smooth, so it shows alone with no texture name for about a quarter of a second (clearest at f1260); 'Sanded Smooth' fades in after its own tag. Same as v3 e5, not yet addressed.
findings.fix: render/videos/heritage-hero.mjs, timeline key 'textures' (tex_6): put the 'Primed only' pill on the same layer and fade as the texture name so they appear together after the wipe.

findings.what: The Vanilla Chai, Warm Caramel and Natural White Oak bedroom renders, the Smokey Brown close-up (and the end card's second Kona Brown bedroom view) are not in the manifest's references, so they could not be checked against their Ekena source. They look like the same room and plausible finishes, and Smokey Brown's average colour matches its swatch, but the three stain renders were not verified frame-to-source.
findings.fix: Add the source images for those finishes (and the end-card bedroom view) to references.product_images in the manifest so the next evaluation can check them against Ekena's originals.
